Pizza's R Us
Pizza's R Us was founded in 1985 by the dynamic duo, Maria and Luigi Rossi, in the heart of Wesley Chapel, Florida. The Rossis, originally from Naples, Italy, brought with them generations of authentic Italian pizza-making traditions. They started with a small pizzeria, which quickly became a local favorite due to its use of fresh ingredients and traditional wood-fired ovens.
